failure: Failure: This refutes the usual variance-based FPRAS argument for this iid estimator on this connected family only. The family itself has an elementary exact algorithm. It proves no counting hardness, no lower bound for all estimators, and no general tensor-network variance barrier. Finite selector checks are source-reported and not rerun here.
interface: Interface: The pair gates are F(4,4,1) and bridges F(1,epsilon,epsilon); one selector is drawn independently per gate with probabilities proportional to a,c,d and Y is the product normalizer times the exact selected-word trace. The claim is estimator- and family-specific.

claims.title: An iid loop-selector estimator has exponential second moment on a connected exact path family
